scope: Clean CPU actual-base versus candidate collection loop only; per-request and batch completion, no serving claim
input_form: Exact rendered_text, add_special_tokens=False; expected input_ids from fixture JSON
arrival_process: All tasks created before first yield; each request sleeps its predeclared delay if positive. Record actual enqueue and completion offsets in common minimal wrapper. Requested delays are not asserted identical actual arrival times.

fixed.cpu_dependency_view: Image package files reused; torch_npu and .pth hooks omitted as in L010-R006; no edits to package files

block_design: A/A pair from distinct identical actors, plus A/B pair; interweave pairs with frozen seeded order; persist all rows
metrics: value equality and per-request ID digest outside timing
per-request actual enqueue and completion offsets from batch timer
instrumentation: No tokenizer wrapper or process-method replacement. Same small async request wrapper records two timestamps per request for all actors; included in timed region. Source/model/fixture hashing, output checks and setup outside intervals.
decision_gate: Per-case paired AA and AB log-ratio intervals; preserve all CFS rows and arrival jitter. Report processCPU, whole batch and each request, not only a favorable metric. No p99 or causal native/PD claim. Within-Run paired data is not fabricated into independent before/after experiments.
remaining_serving_gates: Actual enable_dynamic_batch_tokenizer in assigned PD frontend
P/D and MTP preserved; NPU weights/context capacity verification
warmup_arrivals: 3 simultaneous full-case batches per actor; actual class and worker warmed. Timing arrival schedule only applies to measured samples.
